why: The pre-flight auditor relays these tools' conclusions. Before this they lived only in the author's home directory, so an installed harness found nothing, emitted an advisory CIT-LOC-001 and produced no inviolable finding: the citation gate was a property of one machine, not of the harness. Vendored so an install enforces it.
precedence: CITATION_GATE_TOOLS wins when set, so a working copy overrides these. Update both together; PROVENANCE.json records what was copied.

requires.verify_locators.py: pymupdf (reports GATE_UNAVAILABLE and exit 3 without it)
requires.validate_sources.py: pymupdf (its page readers import fitz); --offline makes no network call

line_endings: LF; git normalises these files, so the record must be taken after normalisation
